answer: Each identity may endorse only 7 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 860 aliases need 860 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. A raven that can be verified, a saffron that can be measured, and a voyage that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
